title: How is Napoleon connected to Pikachu?
description:
France's line of rulers, a state dinner at Versailles and a royal visit to Wrexham connect Napoleon to Pikachu.

Napoleon → Emmanuel Macron → Charles III → Ryan Reynolds → Pikachu

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
